tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify one receipt by id (pm_…), in public: the receipt, its hash, id, signature and chain link checked, the receipts that supersede it, and the public key it was signed under.

tools.name: list_receipts
tools.description: List receipts, newest first, by barcode (subject), country (market) or date (since, YYYY-MM-DD); up to 500.

tools.name: get_statement
tools.description: The signed statement for a month (YYYY-MM): receipts issued, by result, by country and by key id, the receipts that supersede earlier ones, and the chain tip.
